ukiepc-2014.notes: The address https://ukiepc.info/2014/2014/ncpc2014problems.pdf now serves the UKIEPC home page (HTML, about UKIEPC 2026) instead of a PDF; a Wayback capture of the PDF is needed. The file name suggests the NCPC 2014 problem set, which should be checked against the UKIEPC 2014 problem list once a real copy exists.

sources.evidence: The file saved under the .pdf address is not a PDF but the HTML front page of the UKIEPC site, announcing UKIEPC 2026 ('Date: 17th October'), with no problem statements.

ukiepc-2020.notes: QOJ dashboard; its Attachments include 'Tutorials (en)' (an editorial file) and 'Statements (en)', neither in our copy; they may be worth capturing as sources.
